rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone stays in a place or situation instead of leaving.

example.english: You don't have to leave so soon; linger for a cup of tea first.
example.traditional: 你唔使咁快走，留低飲杯茶先啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 faai3 zau2 lau4 dai1 jam2 bui1 caa4 sin1 laa1

rows.note: Use this when someone remains barely alive while death is approaching.

example.english: He continues to linger on, waiting for his son to come back for a final visit.
example.traditional: 佢仲吊住條命，等緊個仔返嚟見最後一面。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zung6 diu3 zyu6 tiu4 meng6 dang2 gan2 go3 zai2 faan1 lai4 gin3 zeoi3 hau6 jat1 min6
